2610.11135.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
2610.11135.paper_summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.
2610.11135.paper_summary_zh: 知識追蹤（KT）模型需要大量的登錄學習者，因此新課程或平台開始時沒有可用的模型。在基於大型語言模型（LLM）的KT中，LLM生成答案，我們稱之為系統二；它要麼在目標數據上進行微調，要麼對十個樣本進行推理和投票，這樣的過程較慢且給出粗略的概率。我們詢問是否可以使用現成的系統一LLM，該模型在單次傳遞中直接返回輸入問題的概率，當登錄的學習者很少或沒有時，仍然能夠執行KT。在七個數據集上，Jev在沒有來自目標平台的任何數據的情況下，達到了平均AUC為0.706，超過了在8個學習者上訓練的28個深度KT模型的最佳表現（0.689），並且在所有七個數據集上超過了系統二的思維KT（0.650），其API成本約為1/100。添加示例和來自登錄學習者的相似學習者統計（JevKT）將這一數值提高到0.722；JevKT在最多16個學習者的情況下顯著領先於深度KT，並且在平均情況下最多可達到64個學習者，監督KT在64到128個學習者之間趕上。在我們測試的讀者中，這一增益特定於Jev，因為通過官方的系統一適配器查詢的三個其他LLM在所有七個數據集上均低於Jev，並且讀者替換和污染檢查未發現輸入格式或記憶數據解釋增益的證據。對於新學習者，這一優勢從他們的第一次互動開始就存在，而在所有學習者都已登錄的情況下，對於未見過的項目，深度KT仍然保持領先。
